recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If FHIR-I later reconsiders the R6 normative promotion of SubscriptionTopic itself, revisit the resource standards status and its search parameter statuses together rather than changing the search parameter bundle alone.
issue_request: FHIR-27143 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R5 after SubscriptionTopic search parameters appeared normative even though SubscriptionTopic was not then normative; the approved fix was resource-specific standards-status handling for shared normative SearchParameters used on non-normative resources and matching search-table rendering.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-27143 was found. The related FHIR-25744 implementation trail changed SubscriptionTopic search parameter standards-status extensions from normative to trial-use in commit fede0a935133, and later SubscriptionTopic search-parameter work such as FHIR-39633 preserved trial-use status while restoring and adjusting the search parameters.
additional_context: Current source differs because later R6 normative-status work changed SubscriptionTopic itself from trial-use to normative in commit 270e0ceb7b, and a subsequent status-code cleanup in commit 9987f9c0c3 changed the SubscriptionTopic search parameter bundle back from trial-use to normative. The current CI rendering also shows SubscriptionTopic Standards Status = Normative.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current build-scope SubscriptionTopic source and search parameter source are internally consistent, and reverting only the search parameters to trial-use would conflict with the later resource-level normative status.
